style: ONE isolated production pixel-art modular sprite for Grimspire, orthographic front/side-scroller view, transparent background. Chunky 1x pixel geometry enlarged crisply, only six FLAT dark navy stone tones centred RGB28,34,43. Minimum logical feature 4 pixels.
